meta.notes: All activities are within ~1 hour of Center Strip hotels by walk/bus/rideshare unless noted (Hoover Dam / Red Rock require a car or tour). Social links are platform SEARCH URLs (stable, verifiable) — specific video IDs are not invented. Hours marked 'Check official site' must be confirmed before going; showtimes change by date.
meta.transit: RTC Deuce bus: 24h, every ~10-15 min (7am-1am), Strip fares $4 single / $6 2-hr / $8 24-hr / $20 3-day. Monorail: 7am-2am Mon-Thu, 7am-3am Fri-Sun. Las Vegas has no subway. Source: rtcsnv.com (checked Oct 2026 via secondary guides).
